Reflow

The box below has a fixed width.

This container is one thousand pixels wide, so on a narrow screen its text runs off to the right and has to be scrolled sideways to read.

Text after the box wraps normally. It is long enough to make the page taller than the narrow window, so the window can scroll down to it.
